title.en: FlashAttention: exact attention with online softmax and tiling
title.zh: FlashAttention：结合在线 softmax 与分块技术的精确注意力机制

en.a: Materialized attention fixes the arithmetic but creates an n-by-n memory-traffic defect; online statistics and tiles preserve the exact weighted sum while keeping the matrix out of HBM.
en.b: The prefix-conditioned distribution is unchanged. Only the order in which its numerator and denominator are accumulated changes, and the memory hierarchy decides which accumulation order is affordable.

zh.a: 显式化注意力修正了算术问题，却引入了 n×n 的内存流量缺陷；而在线统计与分块技术在保持矩阵不占用 HBM 的同时，维持了加权求和的精确性。
zh.b: 前缀条件分布保持不变。仅其分子与分母的累加顺序发生改变，而内存层次结构决定了哪种累加顺序在成本上是可接受的。
